name: FlexBooker
description_en:
FlexBooker offers customer appointment booking through an embedded website widget or a hosted landing page. Staff manage the schedule while customers can book, change or cancel appointments, with optional payment and reminder workflows.

Its commercial model combines staff logins with booking volume. That distinction matters for a business with few employees but many reservations: a low staff tier does not mean unlimited appointments at the base price.
description_zh:
FlexBooker 通过网站嵌入组件或托管落地页提供客户预约。员工管理日程，客户可以预约、修改或取消，并可结合付款和提醒流程。

其商业模式同时考虑员工登录数与预约量。员工少但预约多的业务尤其需要注意：较低员工档位不代表基础价格含无限预约。

core_features.explanation_en: Embed a device-adaptive widget or use a hosted booking landing page.
core_features.explanation_zh: 嵌入适配设备的组件，或使用托管预约页。

core_features.explanation_en: Documented provider connections pull external events to block availability; iCal feeds are a separate push route.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档介绍连接日历事件以阻挡可用性；iCal 订阅是另一条单向输出路径。

core_features.explanation_en: When a space opens, waiting customers can receive a text to book it.
core_features.explanation_zh: 名额空出时，候补客户可收到短信前往预约。

en: A consultancy can expose selected appointment types and times through a widget, require intake fields, and optionally collect an upfront payment. official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.en:
A consultancy can expose selected appointment types and times through a widget, require intake fields, and optionally collect an upfront payment. For each booking, compare the customer confirmation, employee calendar and payment state. Test a changed time as well as a new booking; they exercise different lifecycle actions.

The feature page also permits card authorization for a no-show fee instead of immediate payment. Authorization, capture and a later refund are not the same action. Establish the consent and fee policy with the processor before enabling them. No card was authorized or charged in this research.
sections.zh:
咨询业务可以通过组件开放指定预约类型与时间，要求填写资料，并按需预收款。每次预约应对照客户确认、员工日历及付款状态。建议除新增预约外，也测试改期，两者涉及不同生命周期动作。

功能页还支持为爽约费预授权银行卡，而非立即付款。预授权、实际扣款和后续退款并非同一操作。启用前应与处理商明确同意及收费政策。本次未预授权或扣款。

sections.title_en: Distinguish provider sync from iCal output
sections.title_zh: 区分服务连接同步与 iCal 输出
sections.en:
FlexBooker describes bidirectional connections with named providers: bookings are pushed outward and external events are pulled in to block availability. It separately describes staff iCal feeds for sending appointments to other calendar applications. A feed is not evidence of the same inbound conflict behavior.

Choose the exact provider, calendars and account permissions before testing. Create an external busy event and inspect whether the corresponding booking slot closes. When an update is missing, check the original booking and external event rather than creating duplicates. Public descriptions do not specify every provider delay, recurrence exception or recovery guarantee.
sections.zh:
FlexBooker 对列明的日历服务介绍双向连接：向外发送预约，并读取外部事件以阻挡可用时间；另行介绍员工 iCal 订阅，用于将预约输出到其他日历应用。订阅输出不能证明具有相同的输入冲突处理。

测试前应选择具体服务、日历及账户权限。创建一条外部忙碌事件，查看对应预约时段是否关闭。更新遗漏时，先检查原预约与外部事件，避免制造重复。公开说明没有规定每个服务的延迟、重复事件例外或恢复保证。

sections.en:
The pricing page defines an employee as anyone with an individual system login. For one to four employees, it shows $49 per month paid monthly or $39 per month paid annually; larger employee brackets have separate amounts. The page does not explicitly identify the dollar currency code in the read text.

Each plan includes 1,000 booked appointments per month, with each additional block of 500 costing $49. Unlimited clients and locations do not remove that booking allowance. The page says the appropriate employee plan is billed automatically each month. Confirm rounding, annual-plan adjustments and taxes before signup. “No extra credit card fees” on the page should not be expanded into a claim that every processor transaction is free.
sections.zh:
定价页把员工定义为拥有独立系统登录的任何人。一至四位员工档显示月付每月 $49，年付月均 $39；更多员工另有档位。已读文本没有明确美元符号对应的货币代码。

每档每月包含 1,000 次已预约时段，每额外 500 次收费 $49。客户和地点不限不会取消预约额度。页面表示每月自动按适合的员工档位计费。注册前需确认增量取整、年付调整及税费。页面的“不额外收银行卡费用”不能扩展为所有处理商交易都免费。

sections.en:
A fully functional 14-day trial needs no card to begin. The pricing FAQ says cancellation leaves the account active until the billing period ends and then shuts it down. Plan migration and export before relying on that end state.

Prepare appointment types, staff calendars, intake data, cancellation rules and payment policy. Evaluate a full appointment and an opened waitlist place; the vendor describes an SMS invitation to book a released slot, not a measured guarantee that the first person sees it immediately. API/webhooks are listed at no extra cost, but endpoints, credentials, retries and receiver deduplication still need their own review.
sections.zh:
完整功能的 14 天试用开始时无需信用卡。定价 FAQ 表示取消后账户持续到当前计费期结束，再关闭。依赖这一结束状态前，应先规划迁移和导出。

准备预约类型、员工日历、资料字段、取消规则及付款政策。建议评估满员预约和候补空位：厂商介绍发送短信邀请预约释放时段，不能当作第一人即时看到消息的已测保证。页面列出 API/Webhook 不额外收费，但端点、凭据、重试及接收端去重仍需单独审查。

sections.title_en: Scheduling scope and unverified deployment rights
sections.title_zh: 排程范围与未核实部署权利
sections.en:
Appointment businesses that want website booking, calendar blocking and a waitlist can evaluate the combined workflow. A team looking for pure employee payroll or physical building access should not infer those systems from schedule-management wording.

The read material describes a hosted booking service with mobile apps. No self-hosting distribution, software licence, residency commitment or restore procedure was verified. Medical examples in the vendor’s audience list do not establish suitability for a particular regulated workflow.
sections.zh:
希望结合网站预约、日历占用和候补的服务企业，可评估完整流程。寻找纯员工薪资或实体楼宇门禁的团队，不能从日程管理措辞推导出这些系统。

已读材料介绍带移动应用的托管预约服务，未核实自托管发行版、软件许可、数据驻留承诺或恢复流程。厂商受众列表中的医疗示例，不能证明适合某个具体受监管流程。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Booking increment rounding, annual tier adjustment, currency code/tax, processor fees, API recovery, exports and licence were not fully verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未完整核实预约增量取整、年付档位调整、货币代码/税费、处理费、API 恢复、导出及许可。

research_gaps.en: No booking, payment, calendar sync, SMS or recovery test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试预约、付款、日历同步、短信或恢复。
